notes.title: New Demo version available - 0.1.5
notes.content:
Hey guys! A new version of the Demo is out! In this version we have the following changes:

Bugs fixed:
- Game data not resetting after being defeated in a battle
- Possibility of infinite discard and Rounds not decreasing
- Card draw not happening correctly after winning a few times
- Possibility of discarding or playing the hand without having cards selected

Improvements:
- While playing the cards, the ones left in your hand are disabled. Avoiding a bug that occurred due to improper selections at the wrong time

Feel free to join our Discord for exclusive news and play tests! Discord: https://discord.gg/9JS7RxtZ5u
